question: To which left-side reference points must the prescribed measure be extended?
premises: The measure is to be led out.
The reference is on the left side.
The points include the end of the eye and the end of the fold.
inference: The prescribed measure should be extended on the left to the end of the eye and the end of the fold.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical referent of puṭāntake is uncertain.
plain_english: Having extended the measure on the left, it should reach the end of the eye and the end of the fold.
